meets.what: Training walk, about 8 km at a steady pace; head torches from October to March
Club walk on the fells, 12 to 20 km, route posted in the Reading Room window
Club night: talks, slides and the meets list

joinNote: Walk with us twice as a guest, then ask the membership secretary for a form. Adult membership is £32 a year and includes cheaper nights at Blea Ghyll Hut.
address: The Old Reading Room, Fell Lane, Harrowdale, Cumbria CA12 9ZQ
